name: io.github.Applire/applire
title: Applire
description: Self-hosted job applications: vault, truthfulness audit, CVs. Needs a running Applire instance.

runtimeArguments.name: --network
runtimeArguments.description: Join your running Applire instance's Docker network, so the server reaches its database.

instance_network.description: The instance's compose network (see `docker network ls`).

runtimeArguments.name: --env-file
runtimeArguments.description: Your instance's .env: database URL, LLM provider and key, base URL.

instance_env_file.description: Absolute path to the .env next to your Applire docker-compose.yml.

runtimeArguments.name: --volume
runtimeArguments.description: The instance's uploads volume, so imported CVs and photos land where the instance keeps them.

instance_uploads_volume.description: The instance's uploads volume (see `docker volume ls`).

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Pass the agent token from the client environment into the container.

environmentVariables.name: APPLIRE_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your personal agent token: Applire → Settings → Tokens (shown once). The server refuses to start without it.
